rules.title: Simulation Directives & Narrative Pacing
rules.subtitle: Configure execution speed, combat lethality, hazard behavior, and storytelling voice
rules.granularitySubheading: Control how turns are advanced and how quickly AI narratives stream.

turnGranularity.title: Turn Progression Mode
turnGranularity.eventByEventDesc: Advance one clash at a time. Maximizes suspense and tactical detail.
turnGranularity.fullPhaseDesc: Simulate entire Day or Night in one go. Ideal for fast group broadcasts.
turnGranularity.autoplayDesc: Continuous hands-off broadcast streaming with automatic phase transitions.

pacingSpeed.title: Narrative Streaming Speed
pacingSpeed.cinematicDesc: Rich streaming text, dramatic suspense pauses, and full sound cues.
pacingSpeed.normalDesc: Balanced pacing with steady token streaming.
pacingSpeed.instantDesc: Skip text delays; immediate round calculation.

rules.directivesSubheading: Calibrate mathematical combat RNG balance, resource scarcity, and twist rules.

combat.title: Combat Lethality Rate
combat.balancedDesc: Standard survival rate with natural combat flow across 6–8 arena days.
combat.highBloodbathDesc: Aggressive confrontation; rapid casualties and fast 3–4 day matches.
combat.grittySurvivalDesc: Cautious tributes prioritizing stealth and shelter; extended slow-burn games.

alliances.title: Alliance & Betrayal Dynamics
alliances.dynamicPactsDesc: Alliances form organically and fracture over critical resources.
alliances.careerPackDesc: Districts 1, 2, and 4 form cohesive hunting packs early on.

feast.title: Mid-Game Cornucopia Feast
feast.desc: Gamemakers summon remaining tributes to the Cornucopia with vital medicine and weapons when the roster dwindles.

hazardsBound.sponsorAbundanceDesc: Frequent parachute drops with medicine, food, and high-tier weapons.
hazardsBound.sponsorStandardDesc: Occasional survival gifts earned by charismatic or high-kill tributes.
hazardsBound.sponsorFamineDesc: Zero sponsor deliveries; survival depends entirely on foraging and hunting.
hazardsBound.muttationClimaxDesc: Bio-engineered beasts unleashed only in the endgame to force the final confrontation.
hazardsBound.muttationNightDesc: Predatory muttations roam the arena grounds every night.
hazardsBound.disasterModerateDesc: Gamemakers deploy floods, acid rain, or fog when tributes stay idle.
hazardsBound.disasterFrequentDesc: Unrelenting environmental hazards forcing constant movement.
hazardsBound.disasterReactiveDesc: Traps triggered only when combat reaches a prolonged stalemate.

rules.voiceSubheading: Instruct the AI storyteller's tone, vocabulary, and perspective.

narrativeVoice.novelDesc: Immersive, sensory 3rd-person storytelling capturing internal terror and grit.
narrativeVoice.broadcastDesc: Flamboyant, sensationalist, propaganda commentary ala Caesar Flickerman.
narrativeVoice.logDesc: Cold, clinical, military surveillance reports with objective casualty telemetry.

victory.soleVictorDesc: Canonical rule: Exactly one tribute must survive to be crowned Victor.
victory.districtDuoDesc: If the final two surviving tributes are from the same District, both are declared Victors.
